name: kaolin
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.18.0"

package:
  name: kaolin
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/kaolin/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 264132280c4713c9554b7c13a8bcad2c0af4da51105cf6ce06dbf01011748aa0
  patches:
    # v0.18.0 hard-pins an obsolete Cython; remove once a newer release no
    # longer pins tools/build_requirements.txt to Cython 0.29.37.
    - patches/0001-loosen-version-pins.patch
    # pkg_resources is removed from current setuptools; remove once upstream
    # setup.py uses packaging.version or another supported version parser.
    - patches/0002-use-packaging-version.patch

build:
  number: 12
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None"
    # PyTorch 2.13's Windows CUDA builds currently target CUDA 13.0.
    - win and cuda_compiler_version != "13.0"
  script:
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: unix
      then: sed
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - packaging
    - setuptools
    - cython
    - numpy
    - pytorch
    - pytorch * cuda*
    - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
    - libcublas-dev
    - libcusolver-dev
    - libcusparse-dev
  run:
    - flask
    - ipycanvas
    - ipyevents
    - jupyter_client <8
    - openusd
    - pillow >=8.0.0
    - pygltflib
    - python
    - pytorch * cuda*
    - scipy
    - torchvision * cuda*
    - tornado
    - tqdm >=4.51.0
    - warp-lang >=1.7

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - kaolin
      # The v0 import test did not run pip check. Keep the explicitly
      # constrained pip check below as the single dependency check.
      pip_check: false
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        # Work around old jaxlib in the test env that requires flatbuffers <3
        # (only affects pip-check; kaolin does not depend on this)
        - python-flatbuffers <3.0a0
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  homepage: https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia-kaolin
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Pytorch Library for Accelerating 3D Deep Learning Research
  description: |
    NVIDIA Kaolin library provides a PyTorch API for working with a variety
    of 3D representations and includes a growing collection of
    GPU-optimized operations such as modular differentiable rendering,
    fast conversions between representations, data loading,
    3D checkpoints and more.
  repository: https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/kaolin
  documentation: https://kaolin.readthedocs.io/en/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - JennaLipscomb
    - mxr-conda
    - h-vetinari
    - jeongseok-meta
